content.content: The user asks: "Who won the most MVPs among the top 5 scorers in the NBA?" Likely they refer to NBA all-time top 5 scorers: (as of now) Kareem Abdul-Jabbar (38,387), LeBron James (38,000+), Karl Malone, Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan (maybe). Or top 5 scorers are: Kareem, LeBron, Karl Malone, Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan (or maybe Dirk Nowitzki). Actually all-time points list: 1. Kareem, 2 LeBron, 3 Karl Malone, 4 Kobe, 5 Michael Jordan. Among these, MVP awards: Kareem has 6 MVPs; LeBron has 4; Karl Malone has 2; Kobe has 1? Actually Kobe never won MVP (regular season) – he never did. Michael Jordan has 5 MVPs. So most MVPs among top 5 scorers: Kareem with 6. So answer: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar. Provide context.

content:
Among the NBA’s all‑time top‑5 point‑scorers, **Kareem Abdul‑Jabbar** has won the most regular‑season MVP awards.

| Player (All‑Time Points Rank) | Career Points (approx.) | MVP Awards |
|-------------------------------|--------------------------|------------|
| **Kareem Abdul‑Jabbar** (1)   | 38,387                   | **6** (1971, 1972, 1974, 1976, 1977, 1980) |
| LeBron James (2)              | 38,000+ (still active)   | 4 (2009, 2010, 2012, 2013) |
| Karl Malone (3)               | 36,928                   | 2 (1997, 1999) |
| Kobe Bryant (4)               | 33,643                   | 0 (never won a regular‑season MVP) |
| Michael Jordan (5)            | 32,292                   | 5 (1988, 1991, 1992, 1996, 1998) |

**Why Kareem leads:**  
- His six MVPs are the most in NBA history, surpassing even Michael Jordan’s five.  
- The other four players in the top‑5 scoring list have fewer MVPs (LeBron 4, Karl 2, Jordan 5, Kobe 0).

So, the answer to “Who won the most MVPs among the top 5 scorers in the NBA?” is **Kareem Abdul‑Jabbar**.
